title: Make production DAO route mutation impossible without origin authentication
description: P1 security: DaoManager's public process_dao/process_dao_at and even validate_and_process_dao paths proceed to route mutation when origin_validator is None (or source_address is omitted); require_crash_safety does not require authentication. This directly contradicts spec §8.6: a DAO lacking the pinned-key/source/signature profile MUST NOT create, refresh, withdraw, or mutate downward state. Separate an explicitly unsafe test-only semantic helper from production APIs, and make every public root receive path require an exact source plus configured validator/replay persistence before mutation/ACK.
close_reason: Implemented: validate_and_process_dao raises DaoError('DAO origin authentication is required', reason='origin_authentication_required') when origin_validator is None or source_address is None (dao_manager.py:854-865); unauthenticated processing exists only behind the explicit allow_unauthenticated_test flag, separating the test path from production per spec 8.6. 751/751 python/tests/rpl tests pass.
